name: comments
actual:
-- heading
select id, /* inline */ name
from users -- trailing
where id = 1;

name: create_table
actual:
create table account
(
    id         bigint primary key,
    email      varchar(255) not null unique,
    created_at timestamp default current_timestamp,
    constraint fk_user foreign key (id) references users (id)
);

name: cte
actual:
with recent as (select id, user_id, total from orders where created_at > current_date)
select u.id, r.total
from users u
         join recent r on r.user_id = u.id;

name: delete
actual:
delete
from orders
where user_id = 1
  and total < 0;

name: insert_values
join_where
actual:
select u.id, u.name, o.total
from users u
         left join orders o on o.user_id = u.id
where u.active = true
  and o.total > 10
order by o.total desc;

name: multi_statement
pg_create_table
pg_dollar_cast
pg_returning
actual:
with moved as (delete from orders where total < 0 returning id, user_id)
insert into order_archive
select *
from moved
returning id;

name: select_list
actual:
select id, name, email
from users;

name: subquery
actual:
select id, (select max(total) from orders o where o.user_id = u.id) as max_total
from users u;

name: update_set
actual:
update users
set name='A',
    email='a@example.com',
    updated_at=current_timestamp
where id = 1
  and active = true;

name: window
actual:
select id, total, row_number() over (partition by user_id order by created_at desc) as rn
from orders;
